Subject: Telemetry AI - Redwood POC plan and success criteria

Hi Jordan / Priya — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposal so we’re aligned before we kick off the POC: 

Summary of needs (from our discovery):
- Ingest ~10M events/day for 2 weeks (streaming + batch backfill)
- Low-latency alert enrichment (p95 latency target <= 120ms)
- On-prem data residency for raw telemetry (customer will push sanitized samples)

Proposed POC scope and success criteria:
1) Functional: Redwood serves enrichment model against your sample data with correct schema mapping for >95% of records.
2) Performance: p95 latency <= 120ms for enrichment calls at 200 concurrent req/s.
3) Cost/Efficiency: model config and batching profile yields token cost estimate within 20% of target (we’ll show baseline).
4) Reliability: end-to-end run for a 48h window with no more than 1% error rate.

Timeline (proposed):
- 2026-03-22: POC environment ready; kickoff demo and access check (Redwood will provision test tenant).
- 2026-03-23 to 2026-04-06: Evaluation window (2 weeks).
- 2026-04-08: Demo of results and decision meeting.

Owners / asks: 
- Telemetry AI: provide sanitized sample dataset (S3 link or CSV) and a contact to open network ports for outbound calls.
- Redwood: provision POC tenant, share service account and example ingestion script, run initial ingest validation.

Attachments: RDW-Telemetry-POC-Plan-v2.pdf (POC plan & checklist).

Next steps: can you confirm the sample data availability and whether 2026-03-22 works for kickoff?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
